news.raw_snippet: # CAPITAL IDEAS: What is this Cerebras IPO? There have been 142 IPOs in the U.S. stock market year to date as of May 16, 2026, an 11.81 percent increase over the same period last year. Cerebras Systems raised $5.6 billion on May 14 at a valuation of $56 billion, the largest artificial intelligence (AI) IPO ever. Elon Musk’s SpaceX is aiming for a June 12, 2026, IPO launch (pun intended), with a $1 trillion-plus (not a typo) valuation and plans to raise about $75 billion. For comparison, the largest U.S. IPO so far was in 2014, when Alibaba raised $21.8 billion at a valuation of $168 billion. That is a massive shock, and it is understandable that the price of a barrel of Brent crude oil spiked from below $70 to $126 and has since been hovering just above the triple-digit mark (about $108 at the time of writing).

news.raw_snippet: ## What is xAI's stock symbol? Since it is not publicly listed, there is no xAI stock symbol or xAI ticker symbol assigned for xAI. Private companies typically reserve a stock symbol up to two years prior to an IPO, and disclose this when they file a Form S-1 with the Securities and Exchange Commission when they start the IPO process. ## How can I sell xAI stock? xAI stock does not trade publicly on Nasdaq or NYSE because it is still a private company. xAI stock might be available for purchase in the secondary markets, but xAI stock is not available for purchase by the general public, and can not be purchased through traditional brokerage accounts. ## How can I buy xAI stock? Accredited investors can purchase shares in private companies like xAI. Because xAI is privately held, its stock is not available for purchase through public stock exchanges like the NYSE or Nasdaq.
